applications.title: My applications
applications.intro: Keep track of the opportunities you want to apply for. This is only your own record. We do not apply for you.
applications.empty: You have not saved any opportunity yet.

progress.title: My progress
progress.help: Move forward as you complete each step. This is what you tell us. It is not proof that anything was sent.
progress.withdrawnNote: You have stopped this application. You can save it again.

statusHelp.documents_ready: All the documents on the list are ticked.
statusHelp.applied: You say you applied on the official website.

docs.title: Documents checklist
docs.none: No documents are listed for this opportunity.

external.heading: What the provider did
external.title: Status with the provider
external.nothingYet: Nobody has confirmed anything with the provider yet.

report.title: Tell us what happened
report.needApplied: You can use this after you mark the application as "I have applied".
report.locked: This status is already confirmed, so it cannot be changed here.
report.label: What happened with your application?
report.hint: What you tell us is saved as your own words. It stays "not confirmed" until a teacher or the provider confirms it.

code.title: Your reference code
code.give: Give this code to the provider so they can confirm your status.
code.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please write the code down.

help.intro: Tell your teacher what you need help with for this application.

save.hint: This only saves it for you to keep track. It does not apply for you.
